name: FightChoiceMenuItem.FIGHT_CHOICE_REMATCH
role: g_fight_choice_menu_cursor value 0: Rematch, the same fight again (MAIN_LOOP_FIGHT_INIT reusing assets)
evidence: g_fight_choice_menu_cursor (u8, include/bb2.h) is read and stored only by the two post-fight three-item choice menus, both C, both drawing the same panel gpu_DrawModeSizedPanelWithSelectedCellOpaque(1, cursor, ...): fight_InitRotatingViewThreeOptionChoice / fight_UpdateRotatingViewThreeOptionChoice (2B344.c:969-1058, entered from the match-end presentations 2B344.c:808 / :888 / :1233) and fight_InitFighterFocusViewAndThreeItemMenu / fight_UpdateFighterFocusViewAndThreeItemMenuWithConfirmDelayedPhaseChange (9F9C.c:2286-2400, entered at a fight's end: VS, NETWORK and VSCPU after a player loss, 9F9C.c:2459-2474; 28708.c's g_fight_mode_selector switch: STORY (case :1604, entry :1637), CHANBARA (case :1650, entry :1654 after a fighter-0 loss), default (case :1657, entry :1662)). On confirm, 0 starts g_fight_choice_confirm_delay at 1 (it counts up to 0x3C, about 59 frames, under gpu_DrawSelectedStretchedSheetPair) and 1 / 2 start it at 0x3C (they act the next frame); both menus then resolve the cursor the same way: 0 sets g_fight_reinit_reuses_assets = 1, g_fight_menu_restart_count++ and MAIN_LOOP_FIGHT_INIT (the same fight again; TEAM mode in 2B344.c restarts the team match, g_fight_match_cursor = 0 + fight_AdvanceMatch); 1 sets g_menu_mode_subflow_init_pending = 1 and MAIN_LOOP_ROW_MENU_INIT, so menu_UpdateRowMenuAndSubflows runs menu_InitSubflowForMode(g_fight_mode_selector) (25C38.c:224-226): the mode's own sub menu (ROW_MENU_SUBFLOW_ENTRY_MENU, 25C38.c:123-160); 2 sets only MAIN_LOOP_ROW_MENU_INIT, whose init leaves g_row_menu_subflow_state = ROW_MENU_SUBFLOW_TOP_MENU (25C38.c:40). Runtime: story-pov-rematch (tools/trace/scenarios/story-pov-rematch.json: CROSS on Rematch at 13000 restarts the fight) and story-pov-sub-menu (DOWN + CROSS, 'Return to Sub Menu', ends on Select Character). The 9F9C.c menu starts at g_fight_choice_menu_first_cursor = D_800A38D4 < 1 (rematch skipped when D_800A38D4 == 0). git grep: no other reader; no INCLUDE_ASM body touches it
